# Technology Stack

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../), one of its top concepts._

A tool, platform, language, service, or protocol used to build or run a system, as distinct from the concepts the system organizes.

## Scope note

Technology-specific terms belong here rather than under the concepts they implement, so the generic vocabulary stays readable by someone using different tools.

## Editorial note

_An open question about this term, not part of its definition._

Currently, technology and tools are intermingled with concepts, but they will be separated into a separate Systems scheme with the 0.2.0 split from Subjects. Maybe "Technology Foundation" would be a better label because "stack" implies vertical arrangement — consider for version 0.2.0.
